component.name: Discord Linux Overlay
component.summary: A transparent Discord voice overlay for Linux

description.p: A movable, transparent Discord voice overlay built for KDE Plasma Wayland and NVIDIA systems. It shows who is in your voice channel, highlights the people who are speaking, and marks who is muted or deafened, on top of games and applications.

ul.li: Live speaking indicator driven by Discord voice events
Participants, avatars, usernames, mute and deafen badges
Transparent window, click-through, dragging, resizing and anchoring
Configurable opacity, scale, avatar size, spacing, layout and position
System tray, join history, and a CLI for KDE global shortcuts on Wayland

description.p: Requires the official Discord desktop client and your own free Discord application (client id and secret), because Discord's RPC voice API is application-scoped. No Discord token is ever extracted or scraped.

screenshot.caption: The overlay showing speaking, muted and deafened participants

description.p: Initial implementation: Discord IPC client, overlay, settings, tray and CLI.
